rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Quality ladder.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Ship-bar traits present: re-runnable artifact (verifier+reference+plan.md method reusable on any future task), traveling vocabulary ("lock it in", "the grill", "three lenses"), sustained editorial voice in the maintainer block. Arc-peak (9) scoring is a cross-module comparison this single-file read can't resolve numerically.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: One exercise = one bounded activity.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Five phases form one internal arc (diagnose -> match check -> build verifier -> assemble reference/plan.md -> resend), each phase's output feeding the next; not sub-numbered as separate registry exercises. Maintainer Placement line makes this explicit: "the re-send is Phase 5 of this exercise, not a module-level beat; the module file must not carry a second one."

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Modules composable across variants.
rules_evaluated.evidence: `<!--flag:module:spot-gaps-build-the-loop-->` / `<!--flag:no-module:spot-gaps-build-the-loop-->` conditional pair around the walk-away-report sentence and the 'Bring the worktree's work home' section is exactly the VARIANT-marker mechanic (no forked body) the rule requires for whether M6 exists in a given delivery cut.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Three-level completeness.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Strategy frame ("packaging you built against your own failure beats packaging you guessed at") -> runtime artefacts trainer/student read at a blocker (verifier, reference, plan.md; Failure-modes+Decision-points sections) -> sendable close (the walk-away report, three-list format, is evidence a stranger could read).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Pattern-recognition LOs need n≥2 instances with contrast.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Module LO1: "Diagnose your un-packaged send-off through three named lenses... grounded in quoted moments." Phase 1's prompt applies all three lenses to the same transcript and requires "explain what each lens reveals" — three scrutiny conditions with explicit contrast, not a single unexamined read.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Progression-with-variations is the spine.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer block names the 10% recall as the third instance of a recurring move (orient-and-introspect.md, plan-mode-done-right.md, here), each on a different artefact with its own action, and explicitly distinguishes this from the banned verbatim refrain ("progression-with-variation, not the refrain check_pedagogy.md §9b bans").

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Student agency — adults decide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: "No need to read the details, unless you want to be meticulous."; "leave the rest at summary depth"; "Prefer to stay in the exercise session?"; "Same cancel-is-legit rule... stopping when the trace is enough is the result." Moves are marked optional, not paced by fiat.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Delegation — student brings, Claude screens.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Every Claude-directed action (read task.md path, read repo+transcript, build verifier, smoke-test it, assemble reference/plan.md, re-run) touches only local worktree/git/session state Claude already has access to; no Jira/wiki/team-chat surface assumed. Judgment-heavy calls (which failure is dominant, which verifier shape fits) stay explicitly with the student.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Split mega-exercise when phases = distinct skills + distinct artifacts.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Phases have distinct artifacts but chain mechanically with no cognitive break (Phase 2's mapping feeds Phase 3's verifier choice; Phase 3/4's artifacts are consumed by Phase 5) — the counter-clause keeps it one exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Artifact-realism check.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Teach principle + technique — default.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Each verifier shape states WHY it fits alongside WHAT it is ("Right when the failure was qualitative..." / "...has a true-false answer..." / "...drift was the dominant failure"); reference vs plan.md purposes are distinguished by function, not just named.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Auto-fire sim+eval after significant rewrite.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This pedagogy re-fire is itself the auto-fire response following yesterday's rewrite at 1e4ae21 (heading rename, punctuation, banned-word removal).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forcing functions stay, scripted reactions go. Forcing functions live in prompts, not body prose.

The 10% recall line ("Ask Claude to show you where two or three of its quotes appear...") sits in body but carries a maintainer accept-note establishing it as the third instance of a precedented M1/M2 placement, not a fresh violation.
